speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng
text: asked the Minister for Education (a) what is the expected impact of the recent announcement by the Ministry to allow an increase in the pricing cap of school bus fares of up to 13%; and (b) how can families of affected students, especially those with higher special education needs, be assisted.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
text: However, the recent increases in operating costs and manpower shortage have made it more challenging for school bus operators to sustain their operations.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
text: This is part of the larger effort to keep the school bus sector sustainable and minimise the risk of disruptions and inconvenience to parents and our students.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
text: In situations where the low-income families need more help, schools have been and will continue to provide additional financial support.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
text: SPED schools also provide further support to students who may require additional help.

speaker: The Minister of State for Education (Ms Gan Siow Huang) (for the Minister for Education)
text: We will continue to regularly review our support schemes and make further adjustments if needed.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I am very heartened that financial assistance is being given to the students who need help.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: That has created quite a lot of issues on the ground.

speaker: Ms Denise Phua Lay Peng (Jalan Besar)
text: I wonder if there is any way that MOE, beyond the current measures, can provide additional studies and support to deeply understand these issues on the ground, and see if, creatively, we can co-create some solutions to further help the students, the school leaders and the families.

speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
text: Indeed, we want to make sure that our students, who have no choice but to take the school bus, are able to afford the school bus fares.

speaker: Ms Gan Siow Huang
text: For those who require more assistance beyond what is in the baseline support, we welcome them to approach the schools and we will be very willing to provide them with the support.
